comment: THE PROTAGONIST, from the user's own character sheet (art/player/source/character-sheet.png, kept bit for bit; art/player/source/character-sheet.json says where each pose is and which clip it is): every frame is a pose of that sheet with the white background taken off, scaled once per clip so that the head is the same size in every animation, and placed by a translation — nothing is redrawn, recoloured or deformed. Each clip is handed over with `npm run assets:intake` and its sources are archived in art/player/source/delivered/<clip>/. The clips the sheet has no drawing for are NOT declared here: `npm run assets:missing` lists them and the game draws their states with its placeholder until they are delivered. The design this replaced is kept, in the layout of art/player/, in art/player/archive/design-v1/ (and in git commit 48684b9, the last one that had it in the game).

idle.comment: From the character sheet and handed over through `npm run assets:intake` (Idle (resting)): 2 frames of the user's own drawing, every pixel the sheet's — the background taken off, scaled once by a factor given by hand, placed by a translation, nothing redrawn

walk.comment: From the character sheet and handed over through `npm run assets:intake` (Walk): 6 frames of the user's own drawing, every pixel the sheet's — the background taken off, scaled once by the size of the head (it turns, so the eye is no fair measure of it), placed by a translation, nothing redrawn
